ABOUT FIRMVAULT

Your documents.
A firm-owned home.

FirmVault is a WhatsApp-first document intake, filing, retrieval and audit platform for CA, tax and law practices. It doesn’t replace WhatsApp. It gives your documents a home.

Why we built it

Important documents arrive on WhatsApp and get lost in individual chats. Firms need them to belong to the firm.

Security first

Encryption in transit and at rest, group and client-level access, audit trail, and configurable retention.

What’s next

CA and legal editions, then OCR classification, duplicate detection and natural-language search.

05 A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Good questions.
Clear answers.

Want to talk through your firm’s process?
We’re here to help

How do documents reach FirmVault?

Employees forward documents to FirmVault’s WhatsApp number. That forwarding workflow brings files into the firm’s central document process.

How are documents organised?

Documents are stored as Client, Service, Document type, Period. Access follows your groups, with client and matter permissions described in the plans.

What happens to unclassified files?

FirmVault asks which client and category. If you’re busy or the document is unlabelled, it waits in the pending queue until its filing details are ready.

Who is FirmVault for?

CA firms, tax consultants, and law firms that handle client documents and need a consistent place to organise and retrieve them.

What will we see in a demo?

The 15-minute walkthrough covers WhatsApp intake, filing, Pending, retrieval, permissions and audit trail. Send an enquiry to arrange a time and discuss a free trial for your firm.

Are the screens on this page real client records?

No. These are illustrative interface examples with fictional names and files, created to explain the workflow.
